name: Welinq
description: Welinq develops quantum networking hardware and software to interconnect quantum processors into scalable networks. A spin-out from Sorbonne University and CNRS, the company builds the highest-performance quantum memories based on clouds of laser-cooled atoms, enabling distributed quantum computing architectures for data centers.

products.name: Quantum Memory Module
products.description: High-performance quantum memories based on clouds of laser-cooled atoms for interconnecting quantum processors
